title: Too loud and bright
text: Too loud and bright. I really love good white noise and sleep with a fan sound every night. And I’ve seen reviews of purifiers in the past that claimed they were too loud, and I thought that wouldn’t ever be an issue for me personally. But this purifier annoys me. The sound isn’t a good white noise. It’s more of a hum. And even level 2 is way too loud to be running while I’m working from home in the same room. The small light on this is obnoxiously bright too, so at night, even after putting it on the night setting, I have to put a pack of gum over the light to cover it up. I can easily sleep with a normal lamp or bathroom light on, but this light is unnecessarily harsh. I’m not even sure why it needs a light at all really. So even though I love how the filter is only supposed to be changed yearly (as opposed to the every 4 month replacements on the Filtrete Large Room with True Hepa purifier I have), I find it too annoying to use at night or past level 1 during the day. I do enjoy the Filtrete one from Amazon though and it has great reviews at a reasonable price. And it’s not loud or overly bright. I’d recommend checking it out!
